# actions-runner: the doc map for agents

## This repo

- [SYSTEM.md](SYSTEM.md): the docs home. The system: pieces, the law each
  carries, the extraction contract. The one starting point.
- [docs/quickstart.md](docs/quickstart.md): the numbered path from
  nothing to a finished stage, all commands copy-pasteable.
- [docs/how-to.md](docs/how-to.md): day-to-day operation, grouped by
  task: gates for free, one stage, worklog reads, human-gate decisions,
  cold boots, CI wiring, hooks, vendoring.
- [docs/RUNBOOK.md](docs/RUNBOOK.md): the operator's reference: the full
  command surface, every config key, every error string with its fix,
  recovery procedures.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the boundary as rules an agent obeys.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, tests, lint, the change bar.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): vulnerability reporting, scope.
- skills/actions-runner/SKILL.md: the skill form of the boundary.
- [reference/README.md](reference/README.md): where a worked example of
  the design laws lives.
- [examples/example-pipeline.yml](examples/example-pipeline.yml): a
  complete pipeline config (seats, modes, gates, apply vocabulary).
- actions/text-gates/: the composite Action for deterministic text gates
  in CI; actions/example-workflow.yml shows the workflow shape.

## The family (AI ECP)

- the family catalog (the map home; in the private control-plane repo).
- repo-guards: governance kit (gates, hooks, CI shape).
- ecp-toolkit: the control plane CLI (PLANNED).
- agent-workspace-kit: manifest-driven agent-team launcher.
- docs-policy-kit: config-driven docs engine.

Verified 2026-10-22.
